extracted.intended_audience: general readers and enthusiasts of travel, natural history, and 19th-century voyage narratives
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptive, first-person travel and natural-history narrative documenting observations of coasts, peoples, flora, fauna, and local customs during a voyage; useful as an example of 19th-century voyage writing and field observation. Emphasizes scene-setting, anecdote, and natural description.
